confirmed.product_direction: One custom open-source modular business application
confirmed.packaging: One application with different screens and modules according to user permissions; businesses enable the modules they need
confirmed.delivery: One responsive web application first, usable on computers and phones; cross-platform or native clients later as requirements justify
confirmed.current_sales_requirement: Current operation does not require sales; CRM must be optional
confirmed.prioritization: User considers every listed area important; do not ask again to reduce these to three outcomes
confirmed.access_requirement: User permissions govern access to modules, screens and features such as uploading expense receipts and tracking trips
confirmed.financial_separation: Business finances only; record who paid and exclude personal portions of mixed purchases. Do not build household accounting in the initial product.

workflow.completion_authority: Authorized workers can close jobs directly
workflow.time_capture: Both a start/stop timer and manual entry
workflow.trip_tracking: Trip log with driver, vehicle, origin/destination, distance, fuel and toll expenses
workflow.expense_approval: Ordinary submissions receive manager review; authorized users may post directly
workflow.expense_funding: Mostly personal money, followed by reimbursement

money.selling_price: Track expenses to inform quotations; the selling price is the amount agreed for each job
money.customer_payments: Flexible deposits, partial payments and remaining balances
money.missing_receipts: Allow submission with a reason; manager approval required
money.reimbursements: Select several expenses for one payment; allow partial reimbursement and show the remaining amount owed
money.household_scope: Business finances only, with payer recorded and personal portions excluded

pilot_evidence.subsequent_clarification: Current work does not require sales; wants a design for physical work and installation businesses, with restaurant use later
pilot_evidence.interpretation_status: Do not assume a restaurant-specific first release or discard the selected food pilot. Exact current workflow remains undescribed.

product_structure_decision.user_direction: One big app with different screens and modules depending on user permissions or privileges
product_structure_decision.effect: CRM, Work, Resources and Money are modules within one application, not four separately presented applications
product_structure_decision.preserved: Previously confirmed workflows and the outstanding interview questions remain in scope

round_two_interpretation.meaning: Combines the presented options for manager review of worker submissions and direct posting by authorized workers
round_two_interpretation.authority_limit: Direct posting does not by itself grant permission to approve reimbursement or record a payment

round_three_interpretation.pricing: No automatic repricing from actual costs. Estimated cost, agreed customer price, actual cost and collected payments remain separate.
round_three_interpretation.approval_exception: A missing-receipt submission still requires a reason and manager approval; ordinary direct-posting authority does not silently bypass that rule.

round_four_pending.topic: Manager-recorded acceptance of shared/PDF quotes, customer web acceptance, or both
One job with tasks/visits versus projects containing separately tracked jobs
Scheduled automatic recurring work versus manual creation or copying
Warnings with authorized override, blocking conflicts, or no warning
Purchase/usage costing, stock balances, or stock balances plus job reservations

financial_rules_still_to_resolve: How pending versus approved expenses appear in cost reports
Mixed funding, company advances and unused money returned
Separate permissions for expense posting, claim approval, self-approval and recording actual payment
later_interview_topics: What creates customer, supplier, worker and advance balances; partial payments and corrections
Job structure, repeat work, multiple sites, shared trips and multiple workers
Quotes and commercial orders versus internal work
Resource availability, scheduling conflicts, purchasing and inventory depth
Estimated versus actual labor and material costs; overhead allocation
Business boundaries and resources shared across businesses; household accounting is excluded
Role templates, individual grants, assigned-job visibility, customer details and sensitive financial fields
Who may record collected cash, confirm bank payments and record reimbursements
Receipt entry, connectivity, offline capture and reconciliation
Existing data, imports, opening balances and professional-service integrations
Hosting, open-source licensing, updates, backups and launch acceptance criteria
implementation_status: Application implementation and migration have not started; the requested interview is developing the specification
